prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1053; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Houston, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the incident, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the blue sedan that was involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened and what you were doing at the time?

A: It was in a shopping center lot. I was pulling out of a parking space, going slowly, maybe five miles an hour, and I was looking to my right for traffic on the main lane.

Q: What happened next?

A: A pickup coming down the aisle hit the rear quarter panel of my car. I didn't see it coming because it was on my left and I was focused the other way.

Q: Did you stop or pull over after the impact?

A: Yes, I stopped right away. The other driver got out and came over, and we exchanged information. I didn't see any sign he was hurt.

Q: How are you feeling physically since the collision?

A: My neck is really stiff and it hurts when I turn my head. The headache started later that evening. My shoulders ache too, and I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the next day and they diagnosed whiplash. I've been referred for physical therapy, and I have an appointment scheduled for next week.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was driving carefully and I'm trying to get back to normal. I'd appreciate a prompt response on the claim.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
